tonight.headline: The Patriots are in — and Addison went, not the Vikings
body: Bad news first: Wednesday's add was made at 22:38 UTC, but the drop was Jordan Addison, not the Vikings' defence. Addison's hamstring had him back for Week 7; the Vikings are on bye and now sit on your bench as a second defence. It changes nothing this week and makes next week's quarterback add (Allen's bye) cost a defence rather than a receiver.

This week is in order: the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.1 against Bok-aneers' 89.6, ESPN 70%. No starter carries a tag. Nothing to do before Tuten and Fairbairn lock at 07:30 Sunday in London.

case.label: Where it can still go wrong
case.body: Dowdle's return trims Warren's share (priced Monday); Mitchell's return trims Wilson's. Diggs' status for Monday night is unknown until Washington's Thursday report.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A starter added to Thursday's or Friday's report: a new contingency, from the bench backs (Kamara, Monangai) or nobody at receiver — Jefferson and Gordon are on bye.

whatWentWrong.title: The drop was Addison, not the Vikings
whatWentWrong.lead: The Patriots were added as advised; the receiver back in Week 7 went instead of the defence on bye.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: Week 7 takes Allen, Tuten and McLaurin. Jefferson returns; Addison would have covered McLaurin's slot. The Vikings, now a second defence, are the only roster spot with no use.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Next Tuesday's quarterback add for Allen's bye drops the Vikings. Winston is on the watch list for it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Addison claimed by a rival and starting for them — then it is a lost asset, not just a spot. Reported back in Week 7 (Fantasy Footballers, 11 Oct).
